Purple vinyl, limited to 3000 copies, individually numbered in a small white box, bottom rear.


This recording is dedicated to the memory of U. 'Mandolin' Shrinivas

Recorded at Mediastarz Studio, Monaco by Jean-Michel Aublette
Recorded at Swara Yogo Studios, Covington, WA, USA and Offbeat Music Ventures, Chennai by Aditya Srinivasan
Recorded at Lambodara Studios, Navi Mumbai by Ameya Mategaonkar
Mixed at Eastcote Studio, London. Engineer: Gorge Murphy
Mastering at Blue Studio, London. Engineer: Andrew Tulloch

Art and Design by Mrinalini Sen, Urmi Bhanja & Orku Basu for TogetherlyHQ.com
Photo by Pepe Gomes • Publicity by Madink PR

All works by John Mclaughlin published by Buma/Stemra
All works by Zakir Hussain published by Precious Time Publishing/ASCAP
All works by Selvaganesh Vinayakaram published by BMI
All works by Shankar Mahadevan published by ASCAP

First new studio album in 46 years or so.
